set_by: user choice on 2026-09-26: confirm on a fresh dev split, then evaluate once on the OpenOOD ImageNet-1K test
written_before: dev2 splits, features and TINS runs exist

dev2_design.heldout: 100 classes, same rules as dev1 (direct WordNet parents, at most one per parent, duplicate-name classes excluded), and none of dev1's 100 held-out classes
dev2_design.support_calib: TINS 16-shot list: first 12 lines support, last 4 calib (as dev1)
dev2_design.id_dev: 20 train images per ID class, not shots, not any dev1 id_dev/near_dev image (by file and sha256), not byte-identical to a sealed image
dev2_design.near_dev: 50 train images per held-out class, not any dev1 id_dev/near_dev image, not byte-identical to a sealed image
dev2_design.far_dev: OpenOOD OpenImage-O val list (same images as dev1; far is not independent)
dev2_design.tins: upstream 194759d + logging hooks, Codex's hyper-parameters, 900-label setup rebuilt with upstream functions, input features from upstream's stream path

primary.score: fused(x) = S_final(x) * p_d(x); d = frozen visual view with DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS features, m = 2, K(x) = CLIP zero-shot top-5 over the 900 ID labels (TINS template), LOO med/MAD shrunk with n0 = 12; p_d(x) = (1 + #{calib d >= d(x)}) / (n_calib + 1)

criteria.near: mean over order seeds of AUROC_near(fused) - mean AUROC_near(TINS S_final) >= 0.05
criteria.far: mean AUROC_far(fused) >= max(mean AUROC_far(TINS S_final), AUROC_far(d only))

secondary.rule: VINS seed level with K(x) = top-5 classes by cosine to DINOv2 visual prototypes (mean of the 12 support features), DINOv2 view, m = 2, eps = 0.01: mean (c) >= 0.05 and mean (d)[1:1] >= 0.85 over the order seeds

next_step_if_primary_pass: freeze the fused score and evaluate it once on the sealed OpenOOD ImageNet-1K test against TINS and d-only
